liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (3 reviews): Reviewer wants the second-set China Cat and Rider, calling it the best ever; Described as a funky, danceable China>Rider in the second set [18][21][26]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Named as one of the show's highlights [15]
- **Deep elem Blues** (1 review): Reviewer calls it very funky [23]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Described as an intense version [21]
- **Uncle John's Band** (1 review): Listed among the highlights of the show [15]
- **Brokedown Palace** (1 review): Reviewer ranks it among the all-time greats [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1983-09-24.167751.akg.se5.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 23 songs; 164 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [1]. Said about its sound: Minor wind noise throughout [1]
- **gd1983-09-24.146702.fob.unknown.davies.joeb.sirmick.flac24**: source not stated; 23 songs; 164 min [3]. Said about its sound: Very sharp and clear, though some applause has been edited out; light wind noise removed [3]
- **gd83-09-24.neumann.wiley.9200.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 23 songs; 155 min; rated 4.23/5 by 13 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the CD quality is great; Reviewer found the first song sounding like an old, heat-damaged cassette, with terrible quality; Reviewer says the sound is very close and intimate, right in your ear [16][17][21][22][24]
- **gd1983-09-24.163640.senn421.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 22 songs; 163 min [9]
- **gd83-09-24.set1-sbd.wiley.9201.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 10 songs; 62 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [14]. Said about its sound: Soundboard of the first set is fantastic, with Phil's bass especially audible [18]

## Around the show

- Sunny day in the Santa Cruz mountains with a big family picnic atmosphere; the reviewer's first show [15]
- Sunny day; reviewer recalls the band playing on a baseball field, and a friend was impressed by Bobby [16]
- Reviewer's first California show after time on the East Coast and two years in Japan; drove up from San Diego [19]
- Reviewer had just watched dirt track racing at the venue, also known as Watsonville Speedway [22]
- Reviewer had just seen the band in Ventura and thought this show perhaps even stronger [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1983-09-24.167751.akg.se5.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Scott Wiseman; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Scott Wiseman's Master Audience Cassettes; AKG SE-5E mics with CE-1 cardioid capsules > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell UDXLII 90) [1]. Also: Cassette source and transfer by Scott Wiseman, coordinated by Charlie Miller; Nakamichi 700 source fills the start of Alabama Getaway and patches [1]
- **gd1983-09-24.146702.fob.unknown.davies.joeb.sirmick.flac24**: taped by Unknown; transferred by John Davies and Sirmick and Joe B. Jones; source: Source: (FOB) Unknown recording > cassette (low gen) [3]. Also: Taper unknown; transitions and tape flips patched using Tim Wiley's source and another by Michael Gardner and Tony Suraci [3]
- **gd83-09-24.neumann.wiley.9200.sbeok.shnf**: source: FOB-AUD(Neuman KM-84Âs>Sony TC-D5)>MC>C>DAT>CDR [5]. Also: Another source has the soundboard first set; this audience source is the one for the second set; Audience recording with Neumann KM-84 microphones into a Sony TC-D5, then DAT and CDR; seeded to etree by Tim Wiley [5][23]
- **gd1983-09-24.163640.senn421.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 421 mics > Jim Vita's 1st Generation Cassettes [9]. Also: First-generation cassettes from Jim Vita, transferred by Charlie Miller; Nakamichi 700 source patches Alabama Getaway and Drums; Tim Wiley's Neumann KM-84 source supplies Deep Elem Blues, Looks Like Rain, Keep Your Day Job and One More Saturday Night [9]
- **gd83-09-24.set1-sbd.wiley.9201.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>MC>C>DAT>CDR [14]

- Poster by Bobbie Bestic Grateful Dead: [1983-09-24 Santa Cruz County Fairgrounds, Watsonville, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1983-09-24-santa-cruz-county-fairgrounds-watsonville-ca-usa/) [28]
